extra_vocab.en: to change the time or date of something that was planned
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，If you need to reschedule 的意思是「如果你需要改面試時間」，受詞被省略，因為從上下文就知道是指面試。reschedule 可以改到更晚或更早的時間，不一定是延後；通知中常搭配「提前多久聯絡」的要求。

example.en: Whenever the client reschedules, our team updates the shared calendar.
example.zh: 每當客戶改期，我們的團隊就會更新共用行事曆。

example.en: Ms. Lee rescheduled her interview after her train was delayed.
example.zh: 李小姐的火車誤點後，把她的面試改了期。

example.en: Rescheduling the workshop will cost us a small deposit.
example.zh: 把工作坊改期會讓我們損失一小筆訂金。

example.en: Can we reschedule the meeting for Thursday afternoon?
example.zh: 我們可以把會議改到星期四下午嗎？

collocations.zh: 重新預約、改約診或約會時間

example.en: I called the clinic to reschedule my appointment.
example.zh: 我打電話給診所，想改我的預約時間。

example.en: The company agreed to reschedule the interview for next week.
example.zh: 公司同意把面試改到下週。

example.en: The training session was rescheduled for Monday morning.
example.zh: 培訓課程已改到星期一上午。

examples.en: I'm sorry, but I need to reschedule our call to tomorrow.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，我需要把我們的通話改到明天。

examples.en: Bad weather forced us to reschedule the client visit.
examples.zh: 天氣不好，我們只好重新安排拜訪客戶的時間。

examples.en: You can reschedule your delivery on our website at no cost.
examples.zh: 您可以在我們的網站上免費更改送貨時間。

confusable.diff: postpone 專指「延後」到之後的時間，不一定已決定新時間；reschedule 是重新訂一個新時間，可以更晚也可以更早。

example.en: We decided to postpone the interview until the manager returns.
example.zh: 我們決定把面試延到經理回來之後。

confusable.diff: cancel 是取消，活動不再舉行；reschedule 是活動仍會舉行，只是改時間。

example.en: Please cancel the interview if you can no longer attend.
example.zh: 如果你無法再出席，請取消這場面試。

example.en: Please check the schedule before you book a room.
example.zh: 預訂會議室之前，請先看時間表。

example.en: I have an appointment with a client at noon.
example.zh: 我中午和客戶有約。

example.en: We had to postpone the event because of the rain.
example.zh: 因為下雨，我們必須延後活動。

example.en: Please cancel my reservation for Friday night.
example.zh: 請取消我星期五晚上的訂位。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；re-（再次）+ schedule 就是重新安排，像 rewrite、return
schedule + -er，做事的人或工具，像 printer、worker

extra_vocab.en: a small group of people who meet to make a decision or judge something
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，a panel of three managers 是由三位經理組成的面試小組，一起面試應徵者。這是面試通知常見的說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: a panel of 後面接複數名詞（a panel of three managers）；美式英文中 panel 當一個整體時，動詞常用單數。

example.en: The company has set up two interview panels for next week.
example.zh: 公司已為下週設立了兩個面試小組。

example.en: The interview panel includes two managers and one director.
example.zh: 面試小組包括兩位經理和一位主任。

example.en: A panel of experts will review every proposal.
example.zh: 一個專家小組會審查每一份提案。

example.en: The panel discussion starts at two o'clock in Hall B.
example.zh: 座談會兩點在 B 廳開始。

example.en: You can adjust the settings on the control panel.
example.zh: 你可以在控制面板上調整設定。

examples.en: You will be interviewed by a panel of senior managers.
examples.zh: 你會由一個資深經理小組面試。

examples.en: The panel will announce its decision next Wednesday.
examples.zh: 小組會在下週三公布決定。

similar.diff: committee 是正式、較長期的「委員會」；panel 常是為某件事臨時組成的小組。

example.en: The budget committee meets every month.
example.zh: 預算委員會每個月開會。

example.en: The committee approved the new hiring plan.
example.zh: 委員會核准了新的招聘計畫。

example.en: Each interviewer has a list of questions.
example.zh: 每位面試官都有一份問題清單。

senses.en: a group of people chosen to judge or discuss something

example.en: A panel of judges will choose the winner.
example.zh: 評審團會選出優勝者。

senses.en: a flat board or surface with controls or a special use
senses.distinguish: 出現 control、solar、wall 等字時，指面板或板片。

example.en: The company installed solar panels on the roof.
example.zh: 公司在屋頂裝了太陽能板。
